sessions.title: First class · A place to recommend

tips.주어-동사: 단수 주어는 has / comes. every + 단수명사. 여러 개면 There are + 복수.
tips.동사·시제: be동사 + 동사원형 ❌ (is come). comes from / is from.
tips.문장 구조: Part 3: 답 → 이유 → 예시 → 다시 답으로 마무리.

focus.1: is come from ❌ → comes from. 단수 주어엔 has. 기분은 confused, 원인은 confusing. Part 3는 답 → 이유 → 예시 → 마무리!

cards.gram: ❌ is come from → ✅ comes from / is from. be동사와 일반동사를 같이 쓰지 않아요. 진행형으로 하려면 is coming from.

cards.en: My city has to improve its public transport.
cards.gram: 주어가 단수(my city)면 has to. I / you / we / they만 have to.

cards.en: I was confused by the question.
cards.gram: 사람의 기분은 -ed: I'm confused. 원인(사물)은 -ing: The question was confusing. I'm confusing = 내가 남을 헷갈리게 하는 사람.

cards.en: There are huge differences between Seoul and Busan.
cards.gram: different는 형용사, difference는 명사. 여러 개면 There are + 복수명사(differences).

cards.en: Every city has its own charm.
cards.gram: every + 단수명사 + 단수동사: every city has (❌ every cities have).

cards.ko: 제가 제주도를 추천하는 이유는 자연이 아름답기 때문이에요.
cards.en: The reason why I recommend Jeju is that it has beautiful nature.
cards.gram: The reason why + 주어 + 동사 + is that + 문장. Part 2·3에서 이유를 말할 때 쓰는 구조.

words.ex: The question was confusing, so I was confused.
There is a big difference between the two cities.
It's fine to make up a story in the test.
Back up your answer with a reason.
The reason why I like Busan is that it's near the sea.
